table.retrieve:
SELECT
	itemname= case item.printable WHEN 1 THEN item.name ELSE 'Counter Sale:' + LTRIM(RTRIM(item.customicode)) END,   
	aliasname=item.customicode, 
	packingdesc=item.packingdesc, 
	ordercode = dbo.saleorderheader.ordercode,
	billingdate = dbo.saleorderheader.billingdate,
	socatcode = dbo.saleorderheader.socatcode,
	saleordercategory = saleordercategory.Name,
	amt=saleorderheader.amt,  
	accname = dbo.accounts.name,   
	address = dbo.customer.address1,   
	address2= dbo.customer.address2,   
	salesman = dbo.users.username,   
	saleordercode = dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode,   
	headerno = dbo.saleorderheader.headerno,   
	date = dbo.saleorderheader.date,   
	invdiscperc = dbo.saleorderheader.discperc,   
	misccharges = dbo.saleorderheader.misccharges,   
	flatdisc = dbo.saleorderheader.flatdisc,   
	invsalestax = 0,   
	gcode = saleorderdetail.gcode,   
	icode = saleorderdetail.icode,   
	looseqty = saleorderdetail.looseqty,   
	bonusqty = saleorderdetail.bonusqty,   
	packunits= saleorderdetail.packunits,   
	saleprice= saleorderdetail.saleprice,   
	discperc = saleorderdetail.discperc,  
	porate = (SELECT quotationdetail.porate FROM quotationdetail WHERE saleorderdetail.quotationrowid = quotationdetail.rowid),  
	podiscperc = (SELECT quotationdetail.podiscperc FROM quotationdetail WHERE saleorderdetail.quotationrowid = quotationdetail.rowid),  
	itemflatdisc=saleorderdetail.itemflatdisc,   
	salestax = 0,   
	Id = dbo.saleorderdetail.IDENTITYCOL,   
	posted=saleorderheader.posted,   
	balance=0,   
	unitsalestax = saleorderdetail.unitsalestax,   
	gstperc = saleorderdetail.gstperc,   
	invgstperc = saleorderheader.invgstperc1,   
	custTaxRegno=customer.salestaxregno  ,
	custrefno=dbo.saleorderheader.custrefno,	
	remarks=dbo.saleorderheader.remarks,
	custcode=saleorderheader.custcode,
	manufacturer=(select m.name from manufacturer m where m.manfcode=item.manfcode),
	messages=(select description from message where messagecode=saleorderheader.messagecode),
	DeliveryDeadline = saleorderheader.DeliveryDeadline,
	LateDeliveryCharges = saleorderheader.LateDeliveryCharges
FROM 
	saleorderheader,   
	saleordercategory,
	saleorderdetail,   
	accounts,   
	customer,   
	users,   
	item  
WHERE 
	( dbo.saleorderheader.socatcode  = dbo.saleordercategory.socatcode ) AND
	( dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode = :ar_saleordercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleorderheader.saleordercode = dbo.saleorderdetail.saleordercode) AND  
	( dbo.saleorderheader.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.customer.custcode = dbo.accounts.acccode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleorderheader.usercode = dbo.users.usercode ) AND  
	( dbo.saleorderdetail.icode = dbo.item.icode)    
ORDER BY /*dbo.item.customicode,*/
	dbo.saleorderdetail.saleordercode,
	dbo.saleorderdetail.IDENTITYCOL

objects.name: c_invsalestaxval
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01),2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2)

objects.name: c_sumsalestaxval
objects.expression: sum(round( c_amount  *  gstperc * 0.01, 2) +  Round((looseqty+bonusqty) * unitsalestax ,2) for all)

objects.name: c_grosstotal
objects.expression: Sum((  looseqty   *  (saleprice - itemflatdisc)  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) )

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: /*Round ( Sum((  looseqty   *  saleprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (    discperc * .01 )  )  -  (  salestax   *  looseqty ) ) *  ( 1 -  invdiscperc  * .01 )  -  flatdisc  +  misccharges  +  invsalestax , 0)*/Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -  flatdisc  + misccharges  + salestax , 0)  + Round(sum(c_salestaxval for all ) + Round((Round(sum((round(c_amount,2) ) for all)  *  (1 - invdiscperc * 0.01) , 2) -  flatdisc  )  *  invgstperc  * 0.01,2),0)
